info.title: Transfer Engine
info.description: Simulated internal money only. Financial routes require FINANCIAL_API_ENABLED=true and migration history 1–3. JWT EdDSA/Ed25519 with configured issuer/audience, required exp and nonempty sub; nbf/iat checked when present. No real banking or production-readiness claims.

401.description: JWT missing or invalid; WWW-Authenticate: Bearer

404.description: Resource missing or not owned; also disabled route

503.description: Unavailable, operation in flight, or commit_unknown. Retry-After: 1. For writes reuse the SAME idempotency key and payload; this response does not prove rollback.

post.description: Exactly one UTF-8 JSON object. Unknown, duplicate, differently cased and null fields are rejected. Actor comes exclusively from JWT sub.
